carriers.title: George Washington Keeps Our Fleet Smiling
carriers.description: Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS George Washington (CVN 73) sends a Dental Tiger Team to conduct dental checkups aboard deployed naval vessel. George Washington is the U.S. Navy’s premiere forward-deployed aircraft carrier, a long standing symbol of the United States’ commitment to maintaining a free and open Indo-Pacific, while operating alongside allies and partners across the U.S. Navy’s largest numbered fleet. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Jack D. Barnell)

carriers.title: George Washington Dental Team Boosts Readiness in U.S. 5th Fleet
carriers.description: ARABIAN SEA (Nov. 13, 2026) — A dental tiger team from the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS George Washington (CVN 73) embarked on six destroyers during its deployment, providing dental care to more than 600 Sailors – most recently the Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Shoup (DDG 86), to provide annual dental exams to the crew, supporting operational readiness while ships operate in the U.S. 5th Fleet area of operations.
